extracted.intended_audience: literary critics, editors, short-story writers, and informed readers of literary annuals
extracted.subtask_description: Critical criteria and standards for selecting and evaluating short stories (and short-story collections) for a literary 'best of' list; emphasizes authorial intent, artistic qualities, and technical merits. Draws on examples from 1918 magazine and book publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance of author's point of view and measure of success
rubrics_metrics.description: I have sought to accept the author's point of view and manner of treatment, and to measure simply his degree of success in accomplishing what he set out to achieve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge a story by the aims and method the author adopts rather than by the critic's preferred aims; measure how well the author attains his own purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality / avoidance of personal preference
rubrics_metrics.description: I have permitted no personal preference or prejudice to influence my mind consciously for or against a story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive for objectivity in selection; acknowledge that complete elimination of personal admiration may be difficult but should be attempted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vivid sense of color
rubrics_metrics.description: To a vivid sense of color ... adds a fine appreciation of the Oriental point of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sensory richness and strong color in description that brings place and culture to life is a criterion for excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy of dramatic situation
rubrics_metrics.description: An economy of dramatic situation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Efficiency in plotting and dramatization — the story should accomplish its effect without unnecessary scenes or padding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faithful and accurate cultural/point-of-view representation
rubrics_metrics.description: A fine appreciation of the Oriental point of view; crystalization of the poetry inherent in New York Chinatown life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respectful, convincing rendering of a community's or culture's perspective; authenticity of viewpoint is a merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Realistic / subjective characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: The characterization is almost subjective it is so real.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Characters should feel real, intimate, and psychologically convincing — sometimes rendered in a subjective manner to convey inner life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poetic crystallization of setting and life
rubrics_metrics.description: The story is a fine crystallization of the poetry inherent in ... life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to distill the poetic essence of a milieu or social type into a compact narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portrayal of spiritual values without sentimentality (new realism)
rubrics_metrics.description: Points the way to a new American realism ... portraying the spiritual values of a small Ohio community without sentimentality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conveying deeper spiritual or social truths honestly and soberly, avoiding mawkishness or over-sentimentality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtle humor and poetic elements combined with faithful realism
rubrics_metrics.description: Her characterization ... has a subtle humor and poetry linked to a faithful realism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blend of wit/poetry with grounded realism that enhances characterization and tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reticence / restraint (not over-stressing points)
rubrics_metrics.description: No point is over-stressed. In fact I find a greater reticence in these stories than in [earlier] work, and this is all to the good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of restraint; letting implications and understatement carry weight rather than explicit emphasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allegorical clarity and imaginative attitude
rubrics_metrics.description: An allegory quietly setting forth the essence of the imaginative attitude toward life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using allegory, the story should coherently and quietly embody an imaginative or philosophical stance without becoming obscure or merely didactic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rich, woven imagery (tapestry effect) opening vision
rubrics_metrics.description: Like a shifting tapestry, pictures weave to and fro, and the way is opened to us to see the vision that the unknown Chinese master saw.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interlocking images and scenes that cumulatively reveal an overarching vision or theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear, swift portraiture
rubrics_metrics.description: Here in clear swift portraiture ... Miss Brown has caught the spirit of America.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Economical, decisive描写 that quickly establishes character and tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capturing national or generational spirit / convincing type study
rubrics_metrics.description: Has caught the spirit of America, youthful and eager ... a study of the typical young American.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successfully embodying a broader national or generational character so the story serves as a convincing type-study or cultural portrait.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere and nostalgic, dreamlike quality with accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: This story ... is an admirable study in atmosphere. It has all the nostalgia of a half-forgotten dream, and yet it is so confidently set forth that we may enter its background without difficulty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create evocative atmosphere and nostalgia while keeping the narrative clear and approachable to readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style and pictorial excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: Style is not a common quality ... the picture portrayed in 'The Black Pearl' is well nigh flawless.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strong, distinctive stylistic control and vivid pictorial writing are marks of excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal experimentation: prose-poem / apologue and audience fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Is a wilful apologue ... it is really a prose poem without any moral whatever, which will delight the thoughtful while disappointing the serious.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognition that nontraditional forms (prose-poems, apologues) are valid if they serve their intended audience and purpose; judge by fit to audience and effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vivid completeness of detail and suggestive characterization; managed situation
rubrics_metrics.description: With vivid completeness of detail, and characterization which is admirably suggestive, Mr. Cobb manages the situation in such a way that its conclusion is inevitable, yet unexpected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Full, evocative detail combined with suggestive rather than exhaustive characterization; plot shaped so that ending feels both inevitable and surprising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mastery of art and consistent development
rubrics_metrics.description: The mastery of his art ... serves to confirm my prediction ... that [the author] would be one of its four or five best short-story writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evidence of technical mastery and artistic growth across works strengthens a story's standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy of means and finish of construction
rubrics_metrics.description: Forty-five short stories of remarkable technique in small compass, sounding almost every note ... with the utmost economy of means and finish of construction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical precision: doing much with little and presenting a tightly finished structure are key merits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evenness of collection and likely permanence
rubrics_metrics.description: The collection is unusually even and seems sure of reasonable permanence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For collections/anthologies, consistent quality across pieces and signs of lasting value are criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Folk spirit and close observation
rubrics_metrics.description: They have the same rich imagination, deep folk spirit, and close observation which distinguished 'A Munster Twilight.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories rooted in folk traditions and produced by careful observation of local life are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaginative transmutation of facts; broad philosophical outlook; clean human observation
rubrics_metrics.description: Enjoy clean human observation, a broad philosophical outlook, and an imaginative transmutation of facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blend of keen observation, philosophical insight, and imaginative re-shaping of real material indicates high artistic achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delicacy of art / rare subtlety
rubrics_metrics.description: An art so delicate as this is rare.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refined, delicate handling of subject-matter, tone, and form is a distinguishing quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary aim: entertainment (when applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: This book is written solely with the worthy object of entertaining the reader.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that a work whose chief purpose is entertainment can legitimately be judged by its success at entertaining its audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of translation and fidelity to original's artistry
rubrics_metrics.description: All the stories have a finished art, and so has Mr. Torao Taketomo's translation. Translations ... admirably translated in a style which reflects much of the poetry of the original.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For translated works, assess the translator's craft and the extent to which the translation preserves the tone, poetry, and finished art of the original.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usefulness of critical apparatus for educational editions
rubrics_metrics.description: The choice is excellent and introduces the reader to several unfamiliar stories ... The critical apparatus is competent, and the biographical notes should prove useful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In editions intended for school use, include competent explanatory material, introductions, and biographical notes to aid readers and students.
